baseline.trigger_router_current_behavior: only V2_CONFIG_PATH maps to v2; every other path including v2.1 silently falls back to v1

defect.statement: Activating only V2_1_SCHEDULER_ACTIVATED would still register and execute v1 defaults, and v2.1 trigger selection would silently inherit the v1 timetable.
defect.business_effect: The v2 Monday host-gap policy would be lost: the scheduler could run at Monday 09:00 and 09:30 CST instead of suppressing the host-disconnected interval and recovering at 09:50 CST.
defect.activation_gate: all three code conditions and their tests must land atomically

conditions.change: Set DEFAULT_CONFIG_PATH = V2_1_CONFIG_PATH so the registered JobSpec executes v2.1, and assert the registered function resolves the v2.1 config without a manual receipt in scheduler mode.
Make _news_poll_trigger an explicit exhaustive router: v1 -> v1 trigger; v2 -> v2 trigger; v2.1 -> v2 trigger; unknown paths -> ValueError. No else-to-v1 fallback is permitted.

frozen_config_policy.reason: The validated config remains byte-frozen. Its historical preregistration phase-gate fields remain false because the loader currently hash-binds that snapshot; runtime activation is represented by reviewed code and deployment evidence.

out_of_scope: changes to request budgets, pagination, deduplication, PIT, checkpoint, source selection or trading behavior
changes to any authorization receipt, prior evidence, v2.1 preregistration or controlled probe
P4.2b production wiring or P4.3 unlock
trade proposal, order, delegation or trade

required_assertions: DEFAULT_CONFIG_PATH equals V2_1_CONFIG_PATH and the hash-locked default loader returns schema p4.1-news-poll-v2.1.
_news_poll_trigger(V2_1_CONFIG_PATH) has exactly the same fire times as _news_poll_trigger_v2.
The registered JobSpec trigger uses the v2.1 route when ALPHAPILOT_NEWS_POLL_ENABLED=true.
On Monday, v2.1 excludes 09:00, 09:30 and 09:40, includes only 09:50 in the 09 hour, and has 61 unique CST slots.
On Tuesday and Wednesday, v2.1 has 64 unique CST slots per day.
An unknown config path raises ValueError rather than falling back to v1.
V2_1_SCHEDULER_ACTIVATED is true and v2.1 scheduler-mode authorization succeeds without a manual receipt.
Passing a manual receipt in scheduler mode remains forbidden.
Manual migration and validation receipt paths retain their existing hash-bound behavior.
Tests that intentionally exercise v1 use V1_CONFIG_PATH explicitly instead of relying on the production default.

api_restart_point.state_change: Run scripts/restart_api_launchd.sh after the fresh backup and reviewed code/test gate, but before scheduler plist regeneration/bootstrap.
api_restart_point.why_here: com.alphapilot.api owns create_all and run_migrations, and its current process predates the .env remediation. The scheduler only performs read-only database readiness checks.
api_restart_point.expected_service_effect: A brief localhost:8000 interruption while launchd replaces PID 809 and the API executes its startup migration path.
must_verify_before_scheduler_start: new API PID and launchctl state=running
research/trading safety and SQLite integrity unchanged
api_restart_point.failure_action: Stop. Do not start the scheduler; retain API/migration logs and state evidence.

scheduler_plist_point.state_change: Run scripts/start_scheduler_launchd.sh once. Do not manually edit the installed plist and do not call a restart script while the service is unloaded.
scheduler_plist_point.script_behavior: The script renders the hardened template into a temporary plist, validates it, backs up the 2026-08-02 installed plist, atomically replaces it, bootstraps launchd and requires a stable PID.

at least 90 seconds without PID churn, restart loop, duplicate JobRun or SQLite lock
scheduler_plist_point.failure_action: Fail closed, boot out the new scheduler if needed, preserve the failed install/log evidence, and do not run a replacement news_poll.
